$comment: Your Story. The draft is the non-empty answers joined in order, until the ambassador edits the draft itself.

prompts.label: What brought you in?
prompts.example: I'd just left a job I'd had for eleven years and wasn't sure what came next.

prompts.label: A moment that stuck
prompts.example: In my first Build Cycle, our team interviewed library staff, and I realized I was good at asking questions nobody else thought of.

prompts.label: Why you keep coming back
prompts.example: I learn faster with other people than I ever did alone.

prompts.label: Who it's for
prompts.example: If you're figuring out what's next, it's a good place to start.
